Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment reporting in.

 

We’ll be releasing a patch that will bring stability fixes to help you continuously enjoy MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Please refer to the Patch Notes for the details of the changes. Ensure that your game is up to date to enjoy the fixes to the game.

 

▶ [Google Play Store] Marvel Future Fight Link
▶ [Apple App Store] Marvel Future Fight Link

 

Read below for more details regarding this Update.


■ 10/01 Recommendation Update Details:


1. Fixed an issue wherein inventory slots are not increased after purchasing the S.H.I.E.L.D Special Support.

2. Fixed a bug wherein damage is not applied if a character moves while using their skills. (Ex. Luna Snow Tier-3 Skill, etc)

 

Thank you.
